title: field_ops.mobile_sync.change_recorded v1
description: Emitted for every genuinely new (non-replay) field_ops.change_logs row, so a mobile-push bridge can react without polling the pull endpoint (DEBT-FO-005). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :mobile_sync, :change_recorded] telemetry event from MobileSync.record_change. Fields live under `data` (build_envelope/3).

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

entity_type.description: Entity that changed (ChangeLog @entity_types, for example field_order, time_entry, truck_inventory). Consumers must tolerate new values.

entity_id.description: Id of the entity that changed (UUID for every current entity type).

operation.description: What happened to the entity: created, updated or deleted.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence the device uses as its pull cursor.
